analysis.mode: PSNR for deterministic ranking (sigma_prior 1.48<2) + SIGNAL mode for noise step
analysis.rationale: Legal 3-step pipeline, one function per category: sensor noise -> optical blur -> ISP saturation. Global step is unambiguous from V-invariant / S-amplified statistics across all five support pairs. Blur family/severity supported by two independent noise-robust signals plus PSNR ranking. Noise presence proven by smooth-sky texture (target grain cannot be produced by any noise-free blur severity; channel pattern R<B<G matches YCrCb chroma noise clipped in R/B). All steps marked UNCERTAIN because no deterministic-only PSNR can reach 40 dB under noise seed mismatch.
